name: carbon
description: Immediate-mode C++20 UI framework with a macOS look, rendered through WebGPU, Vulkan, OpenGL, OpenGL ES, Direct3D 11 or Direct3D 9

dx11.description: Direct3D 11 renderer backend (needs fxc from the Windows SDK)

dx9.description: Direct3D 9 renderer backend (needs fxc from the Windows SDK)

opengl.description: OpenGL 3.3 renderer backend (no dependency: the host loads OpenGL)

opengles.description: OpenGL ES 3.0 / WebGL 2 renderer backend (no dependency: the host loads OpenGL ES)
